description:
ORBIT QUEST is an interactive 3D space exploration project that allows users to discover Earth, the Moon, and Mars, while exploring real spacecraft, satellites, and scientific instruments used in space missions through interactive experiences and storytelling.

We are looking for teammates with skills in:

Three.js, JavaScript, and web development.

3D modeling and design.

We welcome creative thinkers and passionate learners who want to make space exploration more interactive and engaging!
summary:
ORBIT QUEST — Project Summary

ORBIT QUEST is a bilingual (English and Arabic) interactive 3D website that brings space exploration missions to life.

Visitors can explore interactive globes of the Moon and Mars and discover 24 missions: 16 lunar and 8 Martian. Each mission features a 3D model that users can rotate, zoom in on and examine from different angles.

Every mission page explains its purpose, achievements, role in space exploration and technical details, supported by information sources. Most missions also include recorded narration in both Arabic and English.

Designed for students and young people, ORBIT QUEST makes space science engaging through interactive exploration and storytelling. It also highlights lesser-known missions, including Explorer 49, Luna 13, Hiten and India’s Moon Impact Probe, bringing attention to technologies and achievements that are often overlooked.
details:
ORBIT QUEST is an interactive 3D space exploration website designed to make learning about space missions, tools, and forgotten space technologies more engaging and accessible.

The website allows visitors to explore different destinations, including Earth, the Moon, and Mars, and discover real spacecraft, instruments, and equipment associated with space exploration. Users can select objects to view their 3D models, read general information, and explore their missions and stories.

The project aims to make space science easier and more enjoyable to understand, especially for students and young people. It also highlights the importance of space instruments and technologies that may be overlooked, helping visitors appreciate their contributions to scientific discovery and exploration.

ORBIT QUEST was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with Three.js for interactive 3D experiences and GLB models for 3D objects. Meshy AI was used in creating 3D models, while Claude AI assisted with research, content development, translation, coding, and debugging. The project also uses space-related information and references from NASA and other space agencies.

What makes ORBIT QUEST creative is its combination of 3D exploration, interactive storytelling, and educational information in one experience. Instead of presenting information through traditional articles alone, the project allows visitors to discover space technologies through interactive 3D objects.

During development, the team considered accessibility, ease of navigation, educational value, visual design, and making the experience suitable for young space enthusiasts. The website supports both Arabic and English to reach a wider audience.
